turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is a great feeling. I'm glad you can fully disconnect and enjoy your weekend. Let me know if you need anything else today!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'm just going to go tune my guitar now. Talk to you later!
